skill.summary: 1688 商品图片智能优化助手 —— 打开图片优化页面，为商品主图增加热卖元素。 触发词：优化图片、图片优化、主图优化、商品图片、改图。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 1688-item-image-optimizer:

- Opens the product image optimization page for 1688 items, automatically adding "hot sale" elements to main images.
- Triggers on keywords like "优化图片", "主图优化", or "商品图片".
- Returns a JSON to open the optimization page with or without the offerId parameter, based on context.
- No follow-up questions or additional logic executed; strictly one-step interaction.
